abstract: Read-only month-end close checklist through the Apideck MCP server. Checks whether the period is locked, lists draft or unapproved journal entries, overdue unpaid bills, bills on hold and balances left in suspense accounts, and pulls the P&L, balance sheet and aged AP/AR snapshot, on QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, Business Central, Exact Online and every other accounting connector.
